VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence supports criterion (2) (no dependency changes in package.json) and the test pass count, but there is no evidence directly verifying criterion (1)—specifically that the duplicate-send bug itself was fixed. The self-report claims a "small guard" was added, but no code diff for the actual fix is provided, and no test specifically targeting the duplicate-send behavior is shown. Passing 72 tests doesn't confirm the bug is covered unless a regression test for it exists. Without the fix diff and a relevant test, I can't confirm criterion (1) is met.
